text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days after the troubling rumors about Tosen Jordan started,
I happened to walk past the school gate—

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text: Ah! There you are, Jordan! The teacher's been looking for you!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ugh, yeah. Got a direct call on my phone a minute ago. Just got back now.

text_block_list.name: Classmate
text_block_list.text:
You'd better get over there right away! She sounded pretty ticked off.
Skipping is one thing, but if you don't play it smart, you'll get expelled for real!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Yeah... I know.

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
Skipping classes, skipping tests... As if that wasn't bad enough,
you refuse to run in races, and now you won't even show up for training.

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
...What happened? You worked so hard, even through your injuries.
If something is troubling you, I'd like to hear it.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Nothing really, it's just kinda a drag? I don't even know.

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
...Please give me a serious answer. I'm worried about you.
Have you lost all your motivation?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Like I said, I don't even know why, I'm just sick of it all!

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
......I see. For today, at least finish this worksheet before you head home.
I put together a summary of the main points from this week's classes.

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text: Whenever you feel like talking about racing again, my door is always open.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I told you, even I don't get it myself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few hours after seeing her by the school gate—
I spotted her in an empty classroom, wrestling with the worksheet.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... "Find the natural number such that its square root is a natural number"...?
What even is a natural number? Like, numbers from nature? What does that mean, trees?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Uggghhh! What is this total gibberish nonsense?!
There's no way I'm ever finishing this~~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan slammed her head onto the desk in frustration.
And as she did... the paper tore cleanly in two.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
............*Sigh*.
I'm done. I'm so done. This is impossible. Can't deal with this.

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
How are things going? —Wait... huh? What happened to the worksheet?
...Did you rip it on purpose?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh? Well, I mean, technically I ripped it myself, but... sort of.

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
............I see.
...Understood. It's loud and clear that you have zero motivation.

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
Still...! That doesn't make this okay!
Tearing it up on purpose is unacceptable!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan didn't tear it on purpose.
I expected her to defend herself, but—

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Whatever...

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
You always push everyone away. Why won't you
take things seriously? We can't help you like this.

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
Tell me, have you truly lost your motivation?
Do you really not want to race anymore? ...Really?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Don't know. Don't care.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Everyone says so anyway, so guess that's that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She turned her back in total resignation without clearing up the
misunderstanding. I couldn't just leave her be, so I followed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I caught up, Tosen Jordan was meticulously applying
protective coat to a cracked hoof. Care products lay all around her.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
*sigh* ...Weak, annoying, and doing it in my room makes Ticket-san
cry, which is even more annoying. Seriously, what is your deal, hooves?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
If only... If only you weren't like this............
If you were just tougher—give me a break. For real.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite her exhausted tone, Tosen Jordan
kept caring for her hooves with endless, delicate patience.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing how thoroughly she took care of her hooves,
it didn't seem like she truly wanted to give up on racing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Which made it all the more puzzling
why Tosen Jordan was avoiding races in the first place.
choice_data_list: (I want to know how she really feels.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After watching for an opportunity over the next few days—
I spotted Tosen Jordan slacking off in town.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Huh? What's an Academy trainer want with me?
choice_data_list: I wanted to talk with you.
I was hoping we could talk.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Talk? Ah... Did the Academy tell you to bug me?
Saying I gotta race and show up to training?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Sorry 'bout that, but I'm, like, totally unmotivated.
So hate to break it to ya, but just give up.
choice_data_list: ...I saw you taking care of your hooves.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hah?! Wait, when?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While genuinely apologizing for having peeked...
I wasn't about to back down now that I had a chance.
choice_data_list: And it made me think that you actually do want to run.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Just 'cause I cared for 'em?
Nah... that's not it. It's just, like, I get restless if I don't do something.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
So whether I wanna run or not...
...I dunno.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, what's it to you anyway? Who cares?
Seriously, just leave someone like me alone!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*grumble~*)

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...I just skipped breakfast, okay?!
choice_data_list: How about... I treat you to something?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: H-Hah? Like I'd fall for cheap bait like that! Don't play with me!
choice_data_list: You really just have to eat. That's all.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph. Fine, how 'bout that place?
Let me eat as much as I want there.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan pointed toward
a flashy, junk-food-packed fast food joint.
